events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: Music Television, MTV, launched in 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' as its very first broadcast.

angles.name: The Day The Music Video Arrived
angles.copy: Forty-five years ago today, a cultural phenomenon began that changed music forever. Remember the first video ever played?

events.title: Oasis' Definitely Maybe Anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' in 1994.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Legacy
angles.copy: Twenty-two years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and cemented their place in rock history. What's your favourite track from the album?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place in 1969, becoming a pivotal moment in music history.

angles.name: Remembering Woodstock
angles.copy: It's been 57 years since half a million people gathered for three days of peace and music at Woodstock. An unforgettable moment in time.

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: The music world remembers Elvis Presley, who passed away on August 16, 1977.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: On this day, we pay tribute to the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley. His music and legacy continue to inspire generations.

events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Rapper Tupac Shakur was shot in Las Vegas in 1996, dying days later.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the profound impact of Tupac Shakur, whose voice and lyrics continue to resonate decades after his passing.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on September 18, 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of Jimi Hendrix, a true innovator who redefined the electric guitar. His music lives on.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' in 1969, featuring that legendary zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. The music and that album cover remain absolutely timeless.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking and inspiring.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis and Beady Eye frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock 'n' roll swagger.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his seminal solo album 'Imagine' in 1971, featuring the iconic title track.

angles.name: Imagine The Impact
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A song that continues to resonate with its powerful message of peace and unity.

events.title: First iPod Released Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Changed Everything
angles.copy: Remember life before the iPod? Twenty-five years ago, Apple unveiled the device that changed how we listen to music forever.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic themes to thrilling action, what's your favourite 007 moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering The Beatles' John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedy genius, John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty, always brilliant.

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Wonders
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece. What's your hidden gem from the tracklist?
